Name: Modular Stable
Author: LilyMods
Description:
[center][color=#00ffff][size=6][b][u]Modular Stable[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/20441/20441-1709926141-696245015.gif[/img]

This will let you customise your horse stable into a variety of building designs and features.
Made in mind to not stray too far from the original concept of the building.
Adding more customisation options, to tailor it to your liking, as time goes on.

See pictures for some of the variable options.
I couldn't possibly take pictures of all the different combinations, otherwise I would go mad.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]HorseOverhaul[/url]﻿, thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Goldenrevolver/about-me]Goldenrevolver.[/url]﻿

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4171229?tab=user+files][size=5]Check Out My Other Mods![/size]
[/url]﻿[/center]

Downloads.Description:
-Updated to remove Stardew 1.6 SMAPI related error messages.
-Added two new customisation options for a new item classification of wall mounted objects.
-Support has been added for HorseOverhaul Mod.

Manifest.Name: Lily's Modular Stable
Manifest.Description: A vanilla-esque stable that the user can customise on the fly to suit their equine or mechanical needs.
Manifest.Author: Lily
